summary: Telefonica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a voluntary current report/notice to shareholders) disclosing that its Board of Directors approved Interest on Capital (IoC), a Brazilian tax-advantaged shareholder distribution, on September 14, 2026. The gross amount is R$500 million (17.5% withholding; net R$412.5 million), or R$0.15646482856 gross per share, based on the August 31, 2026 shareholder base, payable by April 30, 2027 to holders of record September 25, 2026. The IoC counts toward mandatory 2026 dividends, subject to shareholder ratification in 2027. Exact record and ex-date: September 25, 2026. Watch per-share recalculation from any buyback repurchases and differentiated-tax documentation due October 2, 2026.
